facts.fact: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority recorded 4,938 cybersecurity incidents from January to September 2026, a CSA officer told an awareness-month engagement at Cape Coast.
The CSA presented counts of 4,938 incidents for January to September 2026 and 4,604 incidents for the whole of 2025, with GH¢209.7 million and GH¢22.5 million in reported losses.
